facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia issued Determination PSD-10 on fees and charges under section 45 of the Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act No. 14 of 2023), effective on gazette publication on 24 December 2025 with a six-month grace period for existing providers, and it repeals the earlier PSD-5 and PSD-10 (2020) determinations.
facts.system: Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act No. 14 of 2023)

facts.fact: PSD-10, made under the Payment System Management Act, 2023, states that it applies to all payment service providers, defined as banking institutions and non-bank financial institutions, and it binds e-money issuers and providers of e-money wallets and instant payments; new applicants and existing providers are assessed against it.
facts.system: Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act No. 14 of 2023)

note: No fact on connection: PSD-10 sets fee standards and states no rule that providers must connect to each other or to a switch.
